items.title: 13.2.2 Problems and Methods of Osmoregulation (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of problems and methods of osmoregulation (PDF 4-6).

blocks.text: Aam taur par meethe pani (freshwater) ke janwar apne mahol se hypertonic hote hain, yaani in ki jism ki rutoobaton mein ghule maddon (namak) ki miqdar bahar ke pani se zyada hoti hai. Is liye osmosis se pani lagataar in ke jism mein ghusta rehta hai, khaas taur par gills jaise aise hisson se jin se pani guzar sakta hai (permeable surfaces). Zaroori namak aur ions (jaise Na⁺ aur Cl⁻) diffusion se jism se nikal kar bahar ke pani mein chale jate hain.

Osmoregulation ke liye yeh janwar pani ko andar aane se rokte hain aur jo zaid pani andar aa jaye use nikal dete hain. Is maqsad ke liye yeh bohat zyada miqdar mein patla (diluted) peshab (urine) banate hain. Namak ki kami poori karne ke liye yeh active transport se namak wapas jism mein le aate hain. Samundari janwaron ke ulat, meethe pani ke janwar shayad hi kabhi pani peete hain.

Zyada tar samundari janwar apne mahol se hypotonic hote hain, yaani bahar ke samundari pani mein namak ki miqdar in ke andar ke tissues se kahin zyada hoti hai. Is liye osmosis se pani gills aur jild ke raste lagataar in ke jism se nikalta rehta hai. Namak diffusion se mahol se in ke jism mein aata rehta hai. Is ke ilawa samundari pani peene se bhi in ke jism mein namak zyada ho jata hai.

Pani ki kami poori karne ke liye samundari janwar lagataar samundari pani peete hain. Yeh pani bachane ke liye bohat thora aur bohat gaarha (concentrated) peshab banate hain. Zaid namak nikalne ke liye gills ke khaas chloride cells tawanai (ATP) laga kar namak ko khoon se nikal kar wapas samundar mein dhakelte (pump karte) hain. Yeh zaid namak gurdon (kidneys) ke zariye bhi nikalte hain. Kuch samundari machhliyon mein rectum mein namak nikalne wale khaas glands bhi hote hain jinhen rectal glands kehte hain. Yeh glands khoon se namak nikal kar digestive tract (nizam-e-hazma ki nali) mein dalte hain, jahan se woh faeces (pakhana) ke saath bahar nikal jata hai.

blocks.alt: Do machhliyan; neele teer pani aur laal teer namak (salts) dikhate hain. (a) Meethe pani ki machhli: khane ke saath pani aur namak munh mein; gills par namak mehnat se andar (active transport); gills aur doosre hisson se pani andar; patla (dilute) peshab bahar. (b) Samundari machhli: khana aur peene ka pani munh mein; gills se namak bahar; gills aur doosre hisson se pani bahar; gaarha (concentrated) peshab bahar.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.4: (a) Meethe pani aur (b) samundari pani mein osmoregulation (kitab ki Figure 13.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: (a) ke labels: Food; Active transport of salts (gills mein jata laal teer); Entry of water through gills and other parts (jism mein jate chaar neele teer); Dilute urine (vent par lamba neela aur chhota laal teer). (b) ke labels: Food & drinking water; Excretion of salts through gills (gills se nikalta laal teer); Water loss through gills and other parts (jism se nikalte teen neele teer); Concentrated urine (chhota neela aur lamba laal teer). Neeche key: neela teer pani ki harkat, laal teer namak ki harkat.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teeron ke rang yaad rakhein: neela = pani, laal = namak. (a) meethe pani ki machhli mein neele teer andar aate hain, kyun ke pani khud ghus aata hai, aur gills par laal teer andar hai, kyun ke namak ATP laga kar andar khencha jata hai; vent par bara neela teer = bohat pani, yaani patla peshab. (b) samundari machhli mein neele teer bahar hain, kyun ke pani nikal jata hai; gills par laal teer bahar hai, kyun ke zaid namak bahar phenka jata hai; vent par bara laal teer = gaarha peshab.

Khushki ke janwar teen raston se pani khote hain: saans ki sateh (respiratory surfaces) se bukhaarat (evaporation), jild se, aur fuzlaat (waste) ke ikhraj ke saath. Inhen yeh yaqeeni banana hota hai ke pani ki aamad (peene aur khane se) aur metabolic pani (jism ke andar kimiyai amal se banne wala pani) mil kar utne hon jitna pani mahol mein zaya hota hai. In janwaron mein osmotic tawazun rakhne ke liye jismani banawat (anatomical), jism ke kaam (physiological) aur rawayye (behavioral) ki adaptations (mutabiqat) hoti hain.

In ki bahar ki tahen (outer layers) aisi hoti hain jin se pani mushkil se guzarta hai (relatively impermeable), taa ke bukhaarat se pani zaya na ho. Maslan insects ka chitin se bana moom wala (waxy) bahar ka dhancha (exoskeleton) hota hai. Reptiles ke keratin se bane waterproof chhilke (scales) hote hain. Mammals aur birds ki jild ke bahar murda, keratin wale cells hote hain, aur jild mein tel banane wale glands bhi hote hain.

In ke gurde (kidneys) pani ko jism ke andar rokne mein bohat aham kirdar ada karte hain. Mazeed yeh ke yeh protein ke metabolism ke bunyadi fuzle ammonia ko urea ya uric acid mein badal dete hain, jinhen nikalne ke liye kam pani chahiye.

Bohat se registani (desert) janwar din ki garmi mein zameen ke andar rehte hain taa ke bukhaarat se pani zaya na ho. Yeh sirf raat ko bahar nikalte hain jab hawa thandi aur zyada nam (humid) hoti hai. Yeh registani podon ke beej khate hain jin mein bohat sa carbohydrate jama hota hai. Kuch janwar, jaise kangaroo rat, sirf metabolic pani par zinda reh lete hain (yeh pani cellular respiration mein zimni paidawar ke taur par banta hai).

blocks.title: Anhydrobiosis (pani ke baghair zindagi):
blocks.text: Kuch invertebrates, jaise tardigrades (water bears), jab jism ka taqreeban sara pani kho dete hain to ek soi hui (dormant) halat mein chale jate hain. Saalon baad jab pani wapas milta hai to yeh dobara zinda aur sargarm ho jate hain.

blocks.prompt: Meethe pani ki machhli patla aur samundari haddi wali machhli gaarha peshab kyun banati hai?
blocks.explanation: Meethe pani ki machhli osmosis se pani hasil karti rehti aur izafi pani nikalna parta hai; samundari machhli pani khoti rehti aur har qatra bachana parta hai, to thora, gaarha peshab nikalti hai.

items: Meetha pani: janwar hypertonic; pani andar aata, namak bahar jata; bohat sa patla peshab, namak active transport se wapas, pani nahin peete.
Samundar: janwar hypotonic; pani bahar jata, namak andar aata; samundari pani peena, thora gaarha peshab, gills ke chloride cells, gurde aur rectal glands namak nikalte hain.
Khushki: pani-band bahar ki tahen (chitin, keratin), pani bachane wale gurde, ammonia se urea ya uric acid, din mein zameen ke andar rehna, metabolic pani.
